en:
I got tired of apps constantly asking me to sign up and showing me ads. I bought my phone, and I just want apps that work. Offline. Without an account. Ever.

That's why I started building Supersimple apps: they do what they say and don't try to siphon your data to make money in the background. I release all of them as open source.

If this app is useful to you, you can chip in below. Thank you!
